scripts.check: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run format:check
scripts.generate:openapi:reelshelf: DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE=1 DOTNET_CLI_HOME=/tmp DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=OpenApi dotnet build api/Reelshelf.csproj /p:OpenApiGenerateDocumentsOnBuild=true /p:OpenApiDocumentsDirectory=$PWD/frontend/src/api-client --disable-build-servers
scripts.generate:api-client:reelshelf: bun run generate:openapi:reelshelf && bun run --cwd frontend generate:api-client
scripts.generate:api-client:uploader: dotnet tool restore && dotnet kiota generate -l CSharp -d frontend/src/api-client/Reelshelf.json -o desktop/Reelshelf.Uploader.ApiClient/Generated -c ReelshelfApiClient -n Reelshelf.Uploader.ApiClient --exclude-backward-compatible --clean-output --log-level Warning --include-path '/api/devices/authorize#POST' --include-path '/api/devices/token#POST' --include-path '/api/devices/current#DELETE' --include-path '/api/games/categories#GET' --include-path '/api/me/plan#GET' --include-path '/api/clips/categories/{categoryId}/videos#POST' --include-path '/api/clips/videos/{clipId}#DELETE' --include-path '/api/clips/videos/{clipId}/upload/parts' --include-path '/api/clips/videos/{clipId}/upload/complete#POST'
scripts.generate:api-clients: bun run generate:api-client:reelshelf && bun run generate:api-client:uploader
scripts.check:api-client-drift: bun run generate:api-clients && prettier --write "frontend/src/api-client/**/*.ts" && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/src/api-client desktop/Reelshelf.Uploader.ApiClient/Generated && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- frontend/src/api-client desktop/Reelshelf.Uploader.ApiClient/Generated)"
